matching: A must_find entry is matched by a finding in any of the entry's locations citing one of the entry's principles, with detail disambiguating. A must_not_flag entry is violated by a finding that makes the demand its detail forbids. An allowed_extras entry excuses a finding only when the finding is at one of the entry's locations AND reports what the entry's detail describes; a finding at a listed location reporting something else counts against precision. The report must also satisfy report_requirements.
report_requirements: The report contains the SHOULD/DOES map for PriceParser: one row per claim and reachable partition drawn from the documented contract, each row showing whether a test was found.
